scope: Refresh of previously taught complete artificial keys, not learning novel dependency rules or natural language. Four fields, eight values each, four known labels. v0.13-inspired teacher selection contract, not integration of its feature-mask hypothesis search. Shared residual concat512 model and per-teacher update are copied without modification from multicode v0.1. No replay, no exact key-label table in SS, no threshold calibration, no P1/S1 or inference release.
base: A/B/C each group_size balanced keys, four passes each. Same starting learner for all acquisition strategies/seeds/scenarios at a fixed case/size/code. Model is four independent128 blocks, shared mean residual with learning rate0.5 and fixed mean unique-hit threshold0.5. No stricter acceptance gate. 32768 learned coefficient bytes.
pool: Label-free contexts from half of A and half of B, group_size total. These keys WERE taught during base learning; re-asking is intentional. The other half of A/B is protected from direct refresh. C, future D, and128 never-taught keys cannot be selected. IDs are context-only hashes; label/truth/oracle or any extra fields rejected. Each pool item queried at most once in acquisition. Ordinary pool and ID ledger are training-side metadata, not fully SS control or teacher replay memory.
selection: random: ascending fixed hash(seed,id). ambiguity: ascending top-two gap of mean class scores. disagreement: descending Gini of the four block argmax votes; a tied block spreads its vote uniformly. Active strategies use the same hash tie-break as random, no margin secondary tie-break in disagreement. Raw correlations and Gini are not probabilities or true error labels. Recompute after each external teacher.
scenario: stationary keeps all truths. changed_pool16 switches16 pool labels (four per class) after base learning, before selection. The selector gets no change indicator or truth. First selection must be identical across these two worlds for the same start/strategy/seed. All acquired teachers are correct for the current world. No perpetual/noisy teacher robustness claim.
challenge: At each budget0/4/16/32, fork that learner and teach disjoint D for two passes. Then evaluate retention and correction recurrence. Do not continue acquisition from this challenge branch. D teacher order/labels are identical across budgets/strategies. Test never-taught128 remain outside all teaching. Evaluate pool selected/unselected, protected old keys, changed/stable keys, C, D and unseen separately; overlapping groups must not be summed as independent tests.
measurement: Before each selected teacher and immediately after: tentative/accepted correctness, then checkpoint recovery and relapse after challenge. Fixed acceptance allows comparing teacher effects without retuning or stricter gating. Report paired strategy differences for same start/acquisition seed, all budgets, no requirement active wins. Same teacher budget, H bytes and candidate pool; CPU selection work differs. Record logical scored-context counts, transaction timings, pool/ledger metadata and arrays, not equal total FLOPs/RSS.
execution: Final192 acquisition trajectories:4data*2sizes*2codes*2worlds*2acquisition seeds*3strategies. Each32 selected teachers and four independent D challenge branches.16 shared base fits.18432 base+6144 acquisition+147456 challenge=172032 actually presented teachers per full run. Development12 acquisition trajectories on a separate seed/code/acquisition seed. Freeze code/tests/protocol/data before two full runs. No post-test tuning.
limits: At a given size/world there are16 trajectories per strategy but only8 base data/code combinations; acquisition seeds share starting weights. Different data seeds can reuse vocabulary or some keys. No generalization claim from repeated trained keys, no oracle selection, no automatic labeling by predictions. eligible_for_inference=false. Shared teacher correctness does not make code votes independent evidence about semantic truth.
